what: an R2 round on the outer and inner rim circles of a tube's top face (the report's ten picks on a ring-shaped top: the round failed after 0.10.1; rebuilt as a plain tube since the design is not in the report)
method: Tube R=18.5, r=11.5, h=33: V0 = pi (18.5^2 - 11.5^2) 33 = 21771.2371. Each rim round removes the square-minus-quarter-disc section (area A = (1-pi/4) 4 = 0.858407, first moment about the round's centre line rho^3/6 = 4/3) swept about the axis (Pappus). Outer rim (convex), section centre at radius 16.5: 2 pi (16.5 A + 4/3) = 97.3737; inner rim (convex, material outside r=11.5), centre at radius 13.5: 2 pi (13.5 A - 4/3) = 64.4333. V = 21771.2371 - 97.3737 - 64.4333 = 21609.4311 mm3. Faces: outer wall, two toroidal rounds, top ring, inner wall, bottom ring = 6.
